title: Enriched model rerun input plan (planned, not yet built)
fundamentals_source: SimFin Free quarterly statements collected in 5-E1E (git-ignored under research/data/simfin/).
point_in_time_rule: Join each fundamental to the price panel by its data-availability date (publish + free-tier lag), never the fiscal period end, to avoid lookahead bias.
planned_feature_families: valuation (P/E, P/B, EV/EBITDA - computed from statements if derived absent)
bank_handling: Bank-template names use bank statement line items; ratios for banks are computed from the bank templates separately.
